out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: No single vantage point; awareness expanded beyond the body, then "out among the pine plantations, at the tops of trees, soaring in a 360-degree awareness," later wind-like gliding over forests and Lake Superior.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A "chute opened" leading into the "other side"; later described as "falling backward" and "swooping up and back into my body."
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Falling backward/backing up; swooping back into the body.

arrival.other_being_detail: Many welcoming beings/voices/arms/hands; "collective memory" / "collective consciousness"; "numinous void."

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as a "numinous void" with chants/voices; later everything "glinted with warm and radiant light."

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Return precipitated by external intervention (EpiPen/medical rescue); later frames staying as a conscious choice despite "divine homesickness."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Anaphylaxis from yellowjacket stings; treated with EpiPen, ambulance/EMTs, corticosteroids.

person_demographics.location_city: Ashland (hospital destination mentioned); Bayfield Peninsula near Lake Superior (farm location)
person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Spiritual community "outside of contemporary religion"; earth wisdom teachings; spiritual teacher/apprenticeship context.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Describes being "spiritually alert" with nature as "true place of worship."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Anaphylaxis/physical shutdown imagery ("switches on a control panel"; only slits of blue light at heart and pineal). Post-return altered language/word-light synesthesia.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with expanded awareness and simultaneous bodily shutdown imagery; life review/inventory precedes arrival/welcome; then rapid forced return via EpiPen/medical intervention.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports seeing self/body while also lacking a single vantage point; awareness both in/around body and expanded over landscape.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived two remaining "beams of life-force" (heart and pineal); strong synesthetic language experience post-return (words as colored musical arrows/light units); prolonged "divine homesickness" and grief at not dying; later reports being very aware of brother's transition after homicide without merging/following.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I remember looking at her and at myself on the sofa, watching my eyes roll back in my head, but 'I' wasn’t there, and there was no single vantage point from which the watching was taking place."; "My awareness became larger than the farm itself."; "The review of my life was effortless"; "welcoming me home"; "I was without form but dissolved into formless everything-ness."; "Over the months that followed, I became incredibly distressed that I did not die."; "Divine homesickness."
